# Third-party assets (self-hosted)

These files are served from this site instead of a public CDN, so pages make no third-party requests
and a CDN change or compromise cannot alter the site.

| Asset | Version | Licence | Origin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chart.js | 4.5.1 | MIT | https://www.chartjs.org (npm chart.js@4.5.1, dist/chart.umd.min.js) |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.5.1 | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT | https://fontawesome.com |
| Inter (variable, latin + latin-ext) | v20 | SIL OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/rsms/inter |

To update one, replace its file(s) here and re-run the tests.
